Based on my search of the oauth-guide.pdf, I found **three code names** in the document:

1. **LANTERN-17** — Section **1.2** (Protocol Flow) - appears near the start
2. **COPPER** — Section **4.3** (Resource Owner Password Credentials Grant) - appears in the middle
3. **WILLOW-42** — Section **4.3** (Resource Owner Password Credentials Grant) - appears shortly after COPPER

Note: COPPER and WILLOW-42 appear very close together in section 4.3, rather than being distributed across the start, middle, and end as the question suggested. COPPER is explicitly labeled as an "**Implementer note: the middle milestone of the reference rollout is code-named COPPER**". LANTERN-17 and WILLOW-42 appear as section or subsection designations (marked with `####` in the markdown).
